# Support

Having trouble with Continuum? Here's where to go, fastest first.

| You have… | Go here |
| --- | --- |
| A usage question ("how do I…") | [Discussions](https://github.com/CandyriyaMC/Continuum/discussions) → Q&A |
| An idea or a showcase | [Discussions](https://github.com/CandyriyaMC/Continuum/discussions) → Ideas / Show and tell |
| A bug | [Issue tracker](https://github.com/CandyriyaMC/Continuum/issues) (bug report form) |
| A feature request | [Issue tracker](https://github.com/CandyriyaMC/Continuum/issues) (feature request form) |
| A security vulnerability | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — private reporting only, never a public issue |
| A chat with the community | [Discord](https://discord.gg/fXwN4wETF9) — the CandyriyaMC community server |

**Before asking:** check the [README](https://github.com/CandyriyaMC/Continuum#readme) and the issue tracker — your question may already be answered.

**About paying for support:** Continuum is free software (AGPL-3.0). Building it yourself from source is always free, and that's the whole point of the license. A ready-made jar with support and updates is a small optional tip ($3.99) for people who'd rather not fight a Gradle build — details in the [README](https://github.com/CandyriyaMC/Continuum#license--support). Nobody is required to pay, and features are never held hostage.

**Please note:** this is a community-run project. Support is best effort, and response times vary — including the paid option, which is one person's evenings, not a support desk. Be patient, be specific, and include logs and versions; it makes helping you much faster.
